task_metadata.research_topic: sampling algorithms for diffusion bridge models in image-to-image translation
task_metadata.research_question: Design a better inference-time sampler for diffusion bridge models that improves FID at very low NFE on paired image-to-image translation tasks.
notes: The task description frames the problem as a custom sampler for diffusion bridge models evaluated on Edges2Handbags and DIODE with FID and low NFE constraints.
The dbim_high_order baseline is a repo-level high-order bridge sampler adaptation; it is linked approximately to DBIM and DPM-Solver rather than claimed as an exact named paper baseline.

tests.label: edges2handbags
tests.notes: Edges2Handbags is the canonical paired image-translation benchmark popularized by pix2pix; FID is the reported evaluation metric in the task description and run script.

tests.label: DIODE
tests.notes: This test runs the bridge sampler on the DIODE paired depth/image benchmark and evaluates outputs with FID.

baselines.name: dbim
baselines.notes: Exact mapping to the Diffusion Bridge Implicit Models sampler family.

baselines.name: ddbm
baselines.notes: Maps to the original Denoising Diffusion Bridge Models sampler.

baselines.name: dbim_high_order
baselines.notes: The repo baseline is a high-order DBIM-style bridge solver; the nearest concrete paper grounding is the DBIM paper plus DPM-Solver-style high-order diffusion ODE updates.

papers.title: Denoising Diffusion Bridge Models
papers.relevance: Introduces DDBM, the exact bridge-model baseline represented by the task's ddbm edit.

papers.title: Diffusion Bridge Implicit Models
papers.relevance: Introduces DBIM, the exact implicit bridge sampling baseline and the paper most directly motivating low-NFE bridge samplers in this task.

papers.title: DPM-Solver: A Fast ODE Solver for Diffusion Probabilistic Model Sampling in Around 10 Steps
papers.relevance: Provides the clearest concrete reference for the high-order diffusion ODE solver ideas adapted by the dbim_high_order baseline.

papers.title: Score-Based Generative Modeling through Stochastic Differential Equations
papers.relevance: Foundational reference for predictor-corrector and SDE/ODE viewpoints that are directly suggested in the task description as sampler-design directions.

papers.title: Denoising Diffusion Implicit Models
papers.relevance: DDIM is a core precursor for deterministic and low-step diffusion sampling, making it relevant background for DBIM-style bridge samplers.

papers.title: Elucidating the Design Space of Diffusion-Based Generative Models
papers.relevance: Relevant for low-NFE diffusion sampler design, especially noise schedule and solver-design choices similar to those exposed in this task's sampler function.

papers.title: BBDM: Image-to-Image Translation with Brownian Bridge Diffusion Models
